No, that statement is not quite right. People actually use their time to work and earn money, not to buy it. Think of a farmer who spends many hours planting seeds, watering crops, and harvesting vegetables. The farmer uses their time and hard work to grow food, which they then sell to get money. So, time is what we spend to create value, and money is what we receive in return for that effort.
